3.name: Improved Critical
3.notes: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

3.name: Remarkable Athlete
3.notes:
You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks.

In addition, immediately after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

7.name: Additional Fighting Style
7.notes: You gain another Fighting Style feat of your choice.

10.name: Heroic Warrior
10.notes: During combat, at the start of your turn, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration if you don't already have it.

15.name: Superior Critical
15.notes: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20 on the d20.

18.name: Survivor
18.notes:
You attain exceptional resilience in battle, gaining the following benefits:

Defy Death. You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws. When you roll 18–20 on a Death Saving Throw, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on it.

Heroic Rally. At the start of each of your turns, if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point, you regain Hit Points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier.
